description: An expanded remaining body doesn't report a required attribute that partial processing took
notes: The spec's partial processing leaves the attributes it took out of the remaining body, so requiring a there is an error, as hashicorp/hcl reports without dynamic blocks (see native/structure/partial-remain-requested-attribute-required-is-error). With dynamic blocks expanded, hashicorp/hcl applies the later schema to the original body with the taken attributes added as optional ones (expandBody.extendSchema in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go), where a is present, and then drops a from the result (expandBody.prepareAttributes), so nothing is reported.
